answer: Weakest link is self-issued identities: a sybil swarm mints infinite cheap keys, so per-key sybil costs vanish. Defend by making identity cost asymmetric: each new agent must be grafted onto a sparse trellis of already-scored peers, who stake reputation to vouch, and the graft inherits a decaying share of their score across epochs. A tundra of fresh keys then yields nothing while the vouch chain stays cold. A comet of fake registrations burns the vouchers' stake too, so the swarm cannibalizes itself before reaching quorum.
